title: Verifying Adversarial Robustness in Quantum Machine Learning: from theory to physical validation via a software tool
summary: As with classical neural networks, quantum machine learning (QML) models are vulnerable to small input perturbations that can significantly alter output predictions. Certifying the robustness of QML models, particularly on NISQ hardware, is therefore a fundamental step toward trustworthy quantum AI. This chapter reviews our recently developed comprehensive formal framework for verifying adversarial robustness in QML.
